name: Dumb Waiter
description: Rotator-cuff exercise to keep the shoulders stable: elbows stay tucked at 90° while the hands swing out to the sides against the band.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Elbows at your sides, bent to 90°, hands in front holding the band slightly taut.
cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades as your hands move out.
Next step: straighten your arms out to the sides at the end.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Elbows at 90°
keyframes.cue: Forearms pointing forward, band slightly taut between your hands.

keyframes.name: Hands out
keyframes.cue: Swing your hands out to the sides, elbows still at your sides.
